stories.title: Accept ARC-022
stories.testEvidence: test/cicd-fail-safe-path-filters.test.ts's 'ARC-022 accepted' suite: 1/1 passing. Also updated the ToC row (DECISIONS.md line 43) to match, not just the entry's own Status field.

stories.title: .NET and Node.js pipelines: exclude-based fail-safe filters
stories.description: Convert include-based (.NET) and unfiltered (Node.js) triggers to a narrow exclude list (D1).
acceptanceCriteria: Both templates use paths.exclude, not paths.include
Exclude list is narrow (docs/journal/governance paths only)
Pipeline/manifest/lockfile paths are never in the exclude list
stories.testEvidence: test/cicd-fail-safe-path-filters.test.ts's '.NET and Node.js pipelines' suite: 5/5 passing, including real YAML parsing (via the already-dependency 'yaml' package) confirming paths.exclude is set and paths.include is absent, a narrowness check (<=6 entries), a negative check that no dangerous path substring appears in the exclude list, and two scenario-class checks (docs-only excluded, brand-new directory not excluded).

stories.title: Terraform and Markdown-lint pipelines: widen include filters
stories.description: Keep include-based filters (correct for their scoped purpose, D2) but widen each to also cover its own pipeline YAML file.
acceptanceCriteria: Both templates' include lists cover their own pipeline definition path
stories.testEvidence: test/cicd-fail-safe-path-filters.test.ts's 'Terraform and Markdown-lint pipelines' suite: 3/3 passing, including a check that the design-nuance reasoning (why include-scoping is correct here) is actually documented in the shipped text, not just decided internally.

stories.title: Commit-metadata prohibition + branch-policy alignment sections
stories.description: New standalone rule (D3) and new documented failure mode (D4).
acceptanceCriteria: Explicit rule against commit message/author/branch-name CI trust signals
Branch-policy alignment documented with a concrete failure-mode example
stories.testEvidence: test/cicd-fail-safe-path-filters.test.ts's 'commit-metadata prohibition and branch-policy alignment' suite: 2/2 passing.
